```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(here)
library(spdep)
library(DHARMa)
library(knitr)
# Reproducibility
set.seed(123)
```

# Data Import and Model Setup
```{r data-import}
# Load main data and best model from 02_glmm_model_selection
bear_count_motion <- read_rds(here("data", "processed_data", "bear_count_motion.rds"))
best_model <- readRDS(here("data", "processed_data", "glmm_best_model.rds"))
```

# Model Diagnostics
```{r diagnostics}
# Simulated residuals
res <- simulateResiduals(best_model, n = 1000)

# residuals vs fitted
p_res_fit <- plotResiduals(res, rank = TRUE) 
png(here("figures","Fig_S1_residuals_vs_fitted.png"), width=1800, height=1400, res=200)
plotResiduals(res, rank = TRUE)
dev.off()

# QQ / uniformity
png(here("figures","Fig_S2_QQ_uniformity.png"), width=1800, height=1400, res=200)
plotQQunif(res)
dev.off()

# Tests table (for appended Table)
ks   <- testUniformity(res)
disp <- testDispersion(res)
zi   <- testZeroInflation(res)
diag_tab <- data.frame(
  test      = c("Uniformity (KS)", "Dispersion", "Zero inflation"),
  statistic = c(unname(ks$statistic), unname(disp$statistic), unname(zi$statistic)),
  p_value   = c(ks$p.value, disp$p.value, zi$p.value)
)
write.csv(diag_tab, here("figures","Table_S1_diagnostics.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# predicted vs observed (rates, since model used an offset)
pred_counts <- predict(best_model, type = "response")
df_po <- transform(
  bear_count_motion,
  pred_rate = pred_counts / total_days,
  obs_rate  = bear_days   / total_days
)

p_pred_obs <- ggplot(df_po, aes(x = pred_rate, y = obs_rate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Predicted rate (foraging days / total days)",
       y = "Observed rate",
       title = "Predicted vs observed (site-level rates)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave(here("figures","Fig_S3_pred_vs_obs.png"), p_pred_obs, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

```

# Spatial autocorrelation
# Note - this part is not possible to run without latitude and longitude (images_public has location data removed due to privacy)
```{r spatial-autocorrelation}
# Extract residuals from model
resids_nb <- residuals(best_model, type = "pearson")

# Run Moran's I
coords <- bear_count_motion %>%
  distinct(station_id, longitude, latitude) %>%
  select(longitude, latitude)

coords_matrix <- as.matrix(coords)
nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords_matrix, k = 4))
listw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W")

moran_nb <- moran.test(resids_nb, listw)
print(moran_nb)
```

# LOSO cross-validation to assess predictive performance
```{r loso-cv}
dat <- bear_count_motion %>%
  filter(total_days > 0) %>%
  mutate(station_id = factor(station_id))

# Define formulas for candidate models (matching 02_glmm_model_selection)
cv_forms <- list(
  H1_global        = bear_days ~ substrate_group + freshwater + prop_coastal_coniferous_forest + human_development + dist_to_salmon_km + offset(log(total_days)),
  H2_resource      = bear_days ~ substrate_group + freshwater + dist_to_salmon_km + offset(log(total_days)),
  H3_disturbance   = bear_days ~ prop_coastal_coniferous_forest + human_development + offset(log(total_days)),
  H4_site_level    = bear_days ~ substrate_group + prop_coastal_coniferous_forest + human_development + offset(log(total_days)),
  H5_null          = bear_days ~ 1 + offset(log(total_days)),
  H3a_dev_only     = bear_days ~ human_development + offset(log(total_days)),
  H3b_forest_only  = bear_days ~ prop_coastal_coniferous_forest + offset(log(total_days))
)

# LOSO folds: one station per fold
stations <- levels(dat$station_id)
folds <- as.list(stations)

score_model <- function(train, test, form){
  train <- droplevels(train)
  # align factor levels between train/test
  fac_cols <- names(Filter(is.factor, train))
  for (col in fac_cols) test[[col]] <- factor(test[[col]], levels = levels(train[[col]]))

  fit  <- glmmTMB(form, family = nbinom2(), data = train)

  mu   <- predict(fit, newdata = test, type = "response")  # predicted counts
  size <- sigma(fit)                                       # NB2 'size' (theta)

  # Predictive log-likelihood on held-out station(s)
  pll  <- sum(dnbinom(test$bear_days, size = size, mu = mu, log = TRUE))

  # RMSE of the rate (bear_days per active day)
  pred_rate <- mu / test$total_days
  obs_rate  <- test$bear_days / test$total_days
  rmse_rate <- sqrt(mean((pred_rate - obs_rate)^2))

  c(pll = pll, rmse_rate = rmse_rate)
}

# Run LOSO for each model
cv_raw_loso <- purrr::imap_dfr(cv_forms, function(form, mname){
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(folds), function(k){
    held <- folds[[k]]
    train_dat <- dplyr::filter(dat, station_id != held)
    test_dat  <- dplyr::filter(dat, station_id == held)
    as.data.frame(t(score_model(train_dat, test_dat, form))) |>
      mutate(model = mname, fold_station = held)
  })
})

# Summarize LOSO performance
cv_loso_table <- cv_raw_loso %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(mean_PLL  = mean(pll),  sd_PLL  = sd(pll),
            mean_RMSE = mean(rmse_rate), sd_RMSE = sd(rmse_rate),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_PLL))  # higher PLL = better

knitr::kable(cv_loso_table, digits = 3,
             caption = "LOSO CV by station (NB predictive log-likelihood & RMSE of rate). Higher PLL, lower RMSE are better.")

# Focused table
keep_models <- c("H5_null","H3a_dev_only","H3b_forest_only","H3_disturbance")
kable(cv_loso_table %>% filter(model %in% keep_models) %>%
        arrange(desc(mean_PLL)),
      digits = 3,
      caption = "LOSO CV (focused): null vs simple baselines vs disturbance.")

```

# Pairwise, per-station deltas vs null
```{r}
# Pairwise, per-station deltas vs null
deltas <- cv_raw_loso %>%
  select(model, fold_station, pll, rmse_rate) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = model, values_from = c(pll, rmse_rate))

# Helper to summarize difference model - null
summ_diff <- function(x, y) {
  diff <- x - y
  list(mean = mean(diff, na.rm=TRUE),
       sd   = sd(diff, na.rm=TRUE),
       t    = t.test(diff)$statistic[[1]],
       p    = t.test(diff)$p.value)
}

out_forest  <- summ_diff(deltas$pll_H3b_forest_only, deltas$pll_H5_null)
out_disturb <- summ_diff(deltas$pll_H3_disturbance,  deltas$pll_H5_null)
out_devonly <- summ_diff(deltas$pll_H3a_dev_only,    deltas$pll_H5_null)

out_forest_rmse  <- summ_diff(-deltas$rmse_rate_H3b_forest_only, -deltas$rmse_rate_H5_null) # negative so "higher is better"
out_disturb_rmse <- summ_diff(-deltas$rmse_rate_H3_disturbance,  -deltas$rmse_rate_H5_null)

out_forest; out_disturb; out_devonly; out_forest_rmse; out_disturb_rmse

```


# Calibration Plot
```{r calibration-plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
# Calibration plot for best model
final_fit <- best_model
pred_counts <- predict(final_fit, type = "response")
pred_rate   <- pred_counts / bear_count_motion$total_days
obs_rate    <- bear_count_motion$bear_days / bear_count_motion$total_days

# Bin predictions into deciles and compute mean observed vs predicted
deciles <- cut(pred_rate,
               breaks = quantile(pred_rate, probs = seq(0,1,0.1), na.rm = TRUE),
               include.lowest = TRUE)
calib <- aggregate(cbind(obs_rate, pred_rate) ~ deciles, FUN = mean)

calib_plot <- ggplot(calib, aes(x = pred_rate, y = obs_rate)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "#0072B2") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  labs(
    x = "Predicted rate (per active day, binned deciles)",
    y = "Observed rate (per active day)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(calib_plot)

ggsave(
  here("figures", "calibration_plot.png"),
  plot = calib_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
